title: Preventing balance updates by adding a new validator in the current block
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  The balance of the user's validators can be updated by creating a new snapshot and proving the balance of the validators. If a user doesn't start a new snapshot in time then anyone can start a snapshot for that user and update the user's balance. Users have an incentive to not update their balances if they get slashed in the beacon chain.
